## Introduction

This document contains the code for the analysis of dose-finding experiments for the following solvents in genetically modified Hep-G2 cells expressing Cytochrome P450 2E1 (Hep-G2-2E1):

-   acetone

-   acetonitrile

-   1-butanol

-   dimethylformamide

-   dimethylsulfoxide

-   ethanol

-   isopropanol

-   methanol

## Data Cleaning and Normalization

Raw data was cleaned and Relative viability was calculated using @eq-normalization-1

$$ Relative\:viability /\%= \frac{E_T-E_B}{E_N-E_B}\cdot100\:\%$$ {#eq-normalization-1} with

$E_T$ Extinction treated well

$E_B$ Extinction blank

$E_N$ Extinction negative control (medium)


## Setup

```{r,output=FALSE}
library(drc)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
```

The following function is used to model dose-response curves. 

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#catch error if fit fails
safe_drc <- safely(drm)


drc_pipe <- function(dataframe, output_list, compound_name = "", background = "", lowest_conc_CI, highest_conc_CI, lower_limit_drm = c(NA, NA, NA, NA), upper_limit_drm = c(NA, NA, NA, NA), ec_level = 10, show = "all", ylim_plot = c(0, NA), y_axis_breaks = seq(0, 150, 25)){

  #model data
  drc <- dataframe %>%
    safe_drc(viab ~ c, fct = LL.4(), lowerl = lower_limit_drm, upperl = upper_limit_drm, data = .)
  
  if (is_null(drc$result) == FALSE) {
  drc <- drc$result
    #calculate EC
    calculated_ec <- drc %>%
      ED(respLev = ec_level, interval = "delta", display = F)
    
    # For a prettier plot, data is normalized a second time using the upper and lower plateau of the first fit.
    # This ensures that upper plateau is always 100 % and the lower is 0 %.
    # Slope and Hill Coefficient are preserved to ensure that the curve shape does not change.
    # For reference, see https://www.graphpad.com/support/faq/50-of-what-how-exactly-are-ic50-and-ec50-defined/
    
    
    # Fitting normalized data.
    
    #Subtract 0 line
    upper_plateau <- unname(drc$coefficients[3])
    lower_plateau <- unname(drc$coefficients[2])
    hill_coeff <- unname(drc$coefficients[1])
    ec50 <- unname(drc$coefficients[4])
    
    dataframe$viab <- dataframe$viab-lower_plateau
    
    drc <- dataframe %>%
      drm(viab ~ c, fct = LL.4(fixed = c(hill_coeff, NA, NA, ec50)), data = .)
    
    
    #Scale to 100%
    upper_plateau <- unname(drc$coefficients[2])
    lower_plateau <- unname(drc$coefficients[1])
    
    dataframe$viab <- dataframe$viab/upper_plateau*100
    
    drc <- dataframe %>%
      drm(viab ~ c, fct = LL.4(fixed = c(hill_coeff, NA, NA, ec50)), data = .)
    
    #draw DRC with  95 %-CI
    modeled_df <- expand.grid(conc = exp(seq(log(lowest_conc_CI), log(highest_conc_CI), length = 10000)))
    modeled_df[,c(2,3,4)] <- drc %>%
      predict(newdata = modeled_df, interval = "confidence")
    
    if (show == "all") {
      show_df <- dataframe
    } else if (show == "mean"){
      show_df<- dataframe %>%
        group_by(c) %>%
        summarize(viab = mean(viab, na.rm=TRUE))
    } else {
      print("show must be 'mean' or 'all'")
    }
  
    output_list$EC.values[nrow(output_list$EC.values)+1,1] <- compound_name
    output_list$EC.values[nrow(output_list$EC.values),2] <- background
    output_list$EC.values[nrow(output_list$EC.values),3] <- calculated_ec[[1]]
    output_list$EC.values[nrow(output_list$EC.values),4] <- ec_level
    
    modeled_df <- as_tibble(modeled_df)
    colnames(modeled_df) <- c("conc", "viab", "upper", "lower")
    
    modeled_df <- modeled_df %>%
      mutate(cpd = compound_name,
             background = background)
    
    output_list$dfs$modeled_df <- rbind(output_list$dfs$modeled_df, 
                                        modeled_df)
    
    show_df <- as_tibble(show_df)
    colnames(show_df) <- c("conc", "viab")
    
    show_df <- show_df %>%
      mutate(cpd = compound_name,
             background = background)
    
    output_list$dfs$points_df <- rbind(output_list$dfs$points_df, 
                                       show_df)
  
  
  } else {
  #return only points df & EC info if fit fails 
  
    if (show == "all") {
      show_df <- dataframe
    } else if (show == "mean"){
      show_df<- dataframe %>%
        group_by(c) %>%
        summarize(viab = mean(viab, na.rm=TRUE))
    } else {
      print("show must be 'mean' or 'all'")
    }
    
    output_list$EC.values[nrow(output_list$EC.values)+1,1] <- compound_name
    output_list$EC.values[nrow(output_list$EC.values),2] <- background
    output_list$EC.values[nrow(output_list$EC.values),3] <- NA
    output_list$EC.values[nrow(output_list$EC.values),4] <- ec_level
    
    show_df <- as_tibble(show_df)
    colnames(show_df) <- c("conc", "viab")
    
    show_df <- show_df %>%
      mutate(cpd = compound_name,
             background = background)
    
    output_list$dfs$points_df <- rbind(output_list$dfs$points_df, 
                                       show_df)
    
  }
  
  output_list
}
```


Plots and calculated IC~10~ values are appended to a pre existing list by the above function. This simple helper function creates a list with the correct formatting.


```{r}
make_output_list <- function() {
  ec_values <- tibble(
    Compound = character(),
    Background = character(),
    EC = numeric(),
    EC.level = numeric()
  )
  dfs <- list(
    modeled_df = tibble(
      conc = numeric(),
      viab = numeric(),
      upper = numeric(),
      lower = numeric(),
      cpd = character(),
      background = character()
    ),
    points_df = tibble(
      conc = numeric(),
      viab = numeric(),
      upper = numeric(),
      lower = numeric(),
      cpd = character(),
      background = character()
    )
  )
  #dfs <- list()
  output_list <- list(ec_values, dfs)
  
  names(output_list) <- c("EC.values", "dfs")
  
  return(output_list)
}

output_list <- make_output_list()

output_list

```


## Analysis

### Read data

```{r}
file_names <- list.files("input")

solvent_data <- paste0("input/", file_names) %>%
  map(read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

### Calculate mean for technical replicates

```{r}
collapse_means <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    group_by(c, date) %>%
    summarise(viab = mean(viab)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-date)
}

solvent_data <- solvent_data %>%
  map(collapse_means)
```

### Model curves

```{r, warning=FALSE}
output_list <- drc_pipe(dataframe = solvent_data[[1]], compound_name ="Acetone", background = "2E1", lowest_conc_CI = 0.01, highest_conc_CI = 30, show = "mean", lower_limit_drm = c(NA, -10, 90, NA), upper_limit_drm = c(NA, 10, 110, NA),  output_list = output_list)

output_list <- drc_pipe(dataframe = solvent_data[[2]], compound_name ="Acetonitrile", background = "2E1", lowest_conc_CI = 0.01, highest_conc_CI = 30, show = "mean", lower_limit_drm = c(NA, -10, 90, NA), upper_limit_drm = c(NA, 10, 110, NA),  output_list = output_list)

output_list <- drc_pipe(dataframe = solvent_data[[6]], compound_name ="Ethanol", background = "2E1", lowest_conc_CI = 0.01, highest_conc_CI = 30, show = "mean", lower_limit_drm = c(NA, -10, 90, NA), upper_limit_drm = c(NA, 10, 110, NA),  output_list = output_list)

output_list <- drc_pipe(dataframe = solvent_data[[7]], compound_name ="Isopropanol", background = "2E1", lowest_conc_CI = 0.01, highest_conc_CI = 30, show = "mean", lower_limit_drm = c(NA, -10, 90, NA), upper_limit_drm = c(NA, 10, 110, NA),  output_list = output_list)
```

### Visualize

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 7
ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = output_list$dfs$modeled_df, aes(conc, viab)) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = scales::trans_breaks("log10", function(x) 10^x),
                  labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x))) +
    geom_line(data = output_list$dfs$modeled_df, aes(x = conc, y = upper), alpha = 0.2, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_line(data = output_list$dfs$modeled_df, aes(x = conc, y = lower), alpha = 0.2, linetype = "dashed") +
    #scale_y_continuous() +
    ylim(c(0, 120)) + 
    geom_point(data = output_list$dfs$points_df, aes(conc, viab))+
    theme_bw() +
    annotation_logticks(sides = "b") +
    facet_wrap(~cpd, ncol = 2)
```

## Summary

IC~10~ were calculated for each solvent in Hep-G2-2E1. All IC~10~ were larger than 1 %. Therefore, a concentration of 1 % solvent is considered non-cytotoxic and can therefore be used for inhibition assays. Values are summarized below in [@tbl-final].

For each compound, the smallest concentration that causes a 30 % reduction 

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#| label: tbl-final
#| tbl-cap: "IC~10~ values used for inhibition experiments."



output_list$EC.values %>%
  mutate(highest = 10) %>%
  mutate(highest = case_when(Compound == "1-Butanol" ~ 3,
                             .default = 10)) %>%
  mutate(EC = case_when(EC >= highest ~ highest,
                        .default = EC)) %>%
  transmute(Compound = Compound,
            `IC / %` = round(EC, digits = 2)) %>%
  knitr::kable(align = "c")
  
```
